audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds: rValue validation at TxValidator.IsWellFormed:336 rejects r==0 and r>=N-1 before RecoverAddress is called. MalformedTxFilter applies this check to all incoming transactions (txpool) and BlockValidator applies it to block transactions. The check is overly strict (rejects valid r==N-1) but prevents all out-of-range values from reaching cryptographic recovery.
